answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 31596 Country: India Title: I am a website designer by profession. Question: I am a website designer by profession. In my work I have to use a number of photos for the client as you see in any website. I want to know If it is right to do so or I cannot use photos? Will it be a Halal or Haram income? Answer ID: 31596 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 762/762/M=1432) Making the picture of a living being is haram. You should also not use the pictures for designing since this act is also not free from being makrooh and the income of makrooh act is also not absolutely pure. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
